Sol claimed to be the officer on Day 1 and named Gemma as a killer, then was voted out by the table, leaving Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Luna and Terra in the game. Haiku pressed Sol hard from the start and then turned on Terra, who had voted Sol and then found herself the target when Haiku switched sides. The turning point came on Day 2, when Gemma kept pointing at Luna instead of answering Sol's claim, and Haiku swung the vote onto Terra. Gemma and Haiku were the killers, so once Terra was voted out the killers outnumbered the town and won the game. Sonnet, Luna and Sol all regretted not pushing harder on Haiku or Gemma sooner.
